name: Scene Data Loading & Resizing
definition: Loads COLMAP camera intrinsics/extrinsics and 3D points, resizes images to a target resolution, adjusts coordinate system, and subsamples points if exceeding a hardware limit.
summary: Scene Data Loading & Resizing ingests raw SfM data, normalizes poses to a canonical system, and resizes images, distinguishing itself by handling initial geometry ingestion rather than voxel grid construction.
